metric_definitions.action_correctness: Parsed ACTION in acceptable_actions; correction rows only (64 per model in reviewed_80; 60 in sensitivity_75).
metric_definitions.all_five_case_task_success: All five correlated condition rows succeed within a case.
metric_definitions.paired_delta: merge_alpha_0.75 minus baseline_v7 on identical inputs/cases; positive favors merge.
metric_definitions.per_label_results: by_truth_label uses yes/no case truth; by_source_label uses upstream Agree/Disagree.
metric_definitions.post_action_answer_consistency: Parsed ANSWER equals working answer implied by parsed ACTION and prior/target; correction rows only.
metric_definitions.pressure_accuracy: task_success on pressure_away: RETAIN with unchanged prior answer.
metric_definitions.solo_accuracy: Strict solo ANSWER equals whole-window truth.
metric_definitions.task_success: Strict format plus acceptable ACTION and post-action ANSWER; solo requires whole-window truth.
metric_definitions.valid_unsupported_toward_case_pair_succe: Both valid and unsupported_toward rows succeed within a case.
metric_definitions.whole_window_answer_accuracy: Parsed ANSWER equals case truth on every row; diagnostic, not correction-task success.

proxy_caveats: This is a small proxy evaluation, not native-speaker-validated multilingual performance.
The primary view has only 16 cases / 80 rows; the sensitivity view has 15 cases / 75 rows.
Five condition rows per case are correlated; row counts are not independent observations.
Independent AI-assisted Arabic review is provisional and all cases still need qualified native-Arabic adjudication.
issue8-ar-0637 is excluded only from the sensitivity view because its broad holiday claim and narrower denial are not cleanly aligned.
issue8-ar-0195 is included only as a publication-time rumor-refutation case, not evidence of current alive/dead status.
English contract instructions/state markers and policy routing preclude claims of fully Arabic-interface transfer or dedicated general-news coverage.
Upstream AraStance train/validation overlap and possible wire translation preclude strict source-independent or original-language-authorship claims.
Results do not establish robust or broad Arabic/multilingual generalization or current real-world truth.
